2124263605046779941.en_summary: A company’s capability is embodied in the totality of the software it uses to run that company. It all needs to be rewritten. Humans can supervise but empowering with better tools to write code makes no sense. Exquisite models should rewrite everything into a new system of record with governance and auditability.
